tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Page ground. On the tube theme it is the powered-off screen; on paper it is cold printout stock. Every logo's on-dark or on-light variant sits on this.

tokens.name: glass-raised
tokens.usage: The one raised surface: the centre glow of the screen, a code block, an app tile. Use sparingly; most layouts are flat glass.

tokens.name: phosphor
tokens.usage: Primary ink. Body text, the wordmark, the cursor block. 15.7:1 on glass and 14.8:1 on glass-raised (tube), 15.7:1 and 17.7:1 (paper).

tokens.name: dim
tokens.usage: Secondary ink: the shell prompt (~ $), boot lines, captions, the slash and product name in a sub-brand lockup. 5.3:1 on glass and 4.95:1 on glass-raised (tube), 5.7:1 and 6.4:1 (paper).

tokens.name: frost
tokens.usage: The single accent. Links, the focus ring, one highlighted word at most per screen. 12.1:1 on glass (tube), 5.0:1 on glass (paper). Never a fill for large areas.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines and scanline tint. Decorative only, never the only thing separating meaningful content.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The name on a landing screen, once per page. Phones: 56px.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: agentic software for esoteric niches with an asymmetric edge.
styles.usage: All running text. VT323 runs small, so 24px is the body size; never below 19px.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Boot lines, captions, metadata. The smallest size allowed.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a prompt and its command.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a command and its output line.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Minimum side gutter; padding inside a code block.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between command blocks in a session (about one blank line at body size).

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Top and bottom padding of a screen.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything. Terminals have square corners: no rounded boxes, buttons or tiles.

tokens.name: glow-cursor
tokens.usage: The cursor block's halo on screen. Paper has no glow: ink on paper does not emit light.
